description: A light wooden tabletop sits in front of a red fabric backdrop, with a small white lamp-like model near the center-right. The left hand rests on the left side of the table while the right hand reaches in from the right, grasps the lamp’s shade, lifts and tilts it upward, then pulls the shade off to reveal the round bulb on the stand and moves the removed shade to the right while keeping it as the right-hand object.
